mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, R.ORDER_ITEM_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.IMAGE_URL, R.CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE R.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, R.ORDER_ITEM_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.IMAGE_URL, R.CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE R.ORDER_ITEM_ID = #{orderItemId}

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, R.ORDER_ITEM_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.IMAGE_URL, R.CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, R.ORDER_ITEM_ID, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, R.IMAGE_URL, R.CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT #{productId} AS PRODUCT_ID, COALESCE(AVG(RATING), 0) AS AVERAGE_RATING, CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID, OI.PRODUCT_ID, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(OI.PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT, '$.productName')) AS PRODUCT_NAME, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(OI.PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT, '$.coverImageUrl')) AS COVER_IMAGE_URL, R.REVIEW_ID FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEWS R ON R.ORDER_ITEM_ID = OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} AND O.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode} AND O.STATUS IN ('DELIVERED','PAID','SHIPPED','PREPARING') ORDER BY OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID ASC
